review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–170). It declares no simp lemmas, attributes or rewrite rules. It contains four theorems and a few `simp only` and `simpa only` calls with explicit lemma lists, so there are no competing or looping rules. I also read `utensorNorm_eq` (UTensor.lean) and `meanFreeVec_eq_sub_spatialAverage` (ExcessComparisonCore.lean). `utensorNorm_eq` is an equation with a product on the right. `meanFreeVec_eq_sub_spatialAverage` has a hypothesis-dependent function-equality form. Both are used with `rw` or `congrFun`. Marking either `@[simp]` would be unjustified: the first expands a definition into a product, and the second needs an integrability side condition, so neither is a clear canonical simp lemma. The file does prove `Continuous vec3EuclideanNorm` inline twice with `unfold` and `fun_prop`, even though a public `continuous_vec3EuclideanNorm` exists in PoincareSobolevL1SliceBasic.lean. That is a lemma-reuse issue, not a simp-interface one, so I did not report it. I did not run Lean, so I can't rule out other simp behaviour.
